content: Render free tier: app sleeps after 15min inactivity, cold start 30-60s -- fatal mid-demo if judge pauses. Free Postgres on Render/Railway/etc auto-deletes after ~30-90 days with no extension, silently wiping demo data. Mitigation: UptimeRobot heartbeat ping every 5min to prevent sleep; know exact DB expiry date relative to demo date.
